missed_items: FEATURE COUNT — three of the 57 derived features are exact duplicates of other derived features, which corrupts the paper's central SHAP-ranking step. Cheon_LGBM.py:96-99: `out["activity_rest_ratio"] = out.get("activity_class_1_ratio", np.nan)`, `out["activity_inactive_ratio"] = out.get("activity_class_2_ratio", np.nan)`, `out["activity_not_worn_ratio"] = out.get("activity_class_0_ratio", np.nan)` — each is a bitwise copy of a column that is already in the matrix. The reader counted these five extra columns toward 17 but never flagged the duplication. Perfectly collinear pairs split mean|SHAP| mass between the copies, so both members are pushed down the ranking that drives forward selection; the same applies more weakly to the 6 class ratios (which sum to 1) and to count = ratio x valid_count (:94-95, :100). The nominal feature count therefore overstates the effective rank.

HYPERPARAMETERS — the Optuna search never leaves its random-startup phase. Cheon_LGBM.py:320-321 `study = optuna.create_study(direction="maximize")` / `study.optimize(objective, n_trials=10)`. Optuna's default TPESampler uses n_startup_trials=10, so with exactly 10 trials every single trial is drawn by the independent random sampler and the TPE model is never fitted. Scenarios 2 and 4 are 10-point random search, not TPE. The reader reported the missing sampler seed (E5) but not that the trial budget makes the sampler choice moot — which also means the '내부 3-Fold Optuna 동적 튜닝' claim in README.md:11 overstates what runs.

SHAP SCOPE — the paper's entire explainability half has no counterpart in the code, and the selected feature set is never recorded. SHAP appears only as an internal ranking inside shap_forward_selection (:229-233); there is no summary plot, no top-20 importance table (paper Figure 6), and no dementia-risk score / one-sample t-test (paper Eq. 2, §4.3). The selected columns are never mapped back to names or saved: `feature_names` is used exactly once, for a count — Cheon_LGBM.py:380 `print(f"\nData Loaded. Shape: {X.shape}, Features: {len(feature_names)}")`, and :262 prints only `Selected {len(best_features)} features`. So even the k that forward selection chose per fold is unrecoverable after the run.

STATISTICS / SHAP — the SHAP accumulation is version-fragile and would crash on newer shap releases. Cheon_LGBM.py:231-233 `if isinstance(shap_values, list): shap_values = shap_values[1]` then `mean_abs_shap += np.abs(shap_values).mean(axis=0)`. Only the legacy list-of-two-arrays return is handled. Recent shap versions return a 3-D ndarray (n_samples, n_features, n_classes) for some tree binary classifiers, which is not a list, so `.mean(axis=0)` yields shape (n_features, n_classes) and the `+=` into a (n_features,) accumulator raises a broadcast error. No environment.txt / requirements pin exists in the folder (only Cheon_LGBM.py, Choi_Ensemble.py, KimPark_LR.py, README.md), so the run is not reproducible against a known shap/lightgbm/sklearn version — a direct contrast with ASSUMPTIONS A23.

PREPROCESSING — a near-textual column can be silently promoted to a numeric feature and then filled with a constant. Cheon_LGBM.py:50-51 `converted = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")` / `if not converted.isna().all(): df[col] = converted` — the column is kept as numeric if even one cell parses. Such a column becomes almost entirely NaN, is then filled wholesale by the global median at :187, passes the `is_numeric_dtype` test at :185, and enters the model as a near-constant. This interacts with the missing all-identical-column removal (paper Preprocessing item 2), which the reader noted only in passing as 'no all-identical-column removal beyond the explicit timestamp drops'.

HYPERPARAMETERS — no class-imbalance handling and no thread/determinism control. Despite the paper's 1.74:1 record ratio (PAPER_PROTOCOL Classification task), no `class_weight`, `is_unbalance` or `scale_pos_weight` appears anywhere; and `n_jobs` is never set on any LGBMClassifier (:226, :248, :314, :326, :328), so LightGBM defaults to all cores. ASSUMPTIONS A12/A26 deliberately fix n_jobs=1 to make per-seed results deterministic; this script gives up that guarantee, so even the seeded scenarios 1/3 may not reproduce bitwise across machines.

STATISTICS — two reporting defects beyond the n=25 CI. (a) Cheon_LGBM.py:213-214 `if std == 0 or len(arr) == 1: return mean, std, mean, mean` — a metric that is constant across all 25 folds (e.g. specificity = 0 in a degenerate scenario) is printed with a zero-width 95% CI rather than flagged. (b) :365 `cm = confusion_matrix(all_y_true, all_y_pred)` is called WITHOUT `labels=[0,1]`, unlike the per-fold call at :204 which does pass them; if the pooled predictions were single-class the heatmap would silently be 1x1 rather than raising.

ROBUSTNESS / SPLIT TYPE — no guard against a degenerate fold. `roc_auc_score` is called at :200 (per outer fold), :251 (per forward-selection step) and :317 (per Optuna inner fold) with no check that both classes are present. StratifiedGroupKFold (:285) only approximately balances classes because whole subjects move together, so a single-class outer test fold is possible in principle and would abort the whole scenario mid-run — and since every result is printed only after all 25 folds finish (:356-363), nothing computed up to that point survives.

ARTIFACTS — the only outputs are written relative to the current working directory, not the script. Cheon_LGBM.py:366 `os.makedirs('outputs', exist_ok=True)` and :375 `plt.savefig(f'outputs/{filename}', dpi=300)`. Launched via the repo's base.ipynb pattern (README.md:77-78 `USER_FOLDER = "Taehyun"` / `RUN_FILE = "Paper_Reproduction_Nested/Cheon_LGBM.py"`), the PNGs land wherever the notebook was started. I independently confirmed the reader's 'no results exist' finding: `find Taehyun -type d -name outputs` returns nothing and the folder contains only the three .py files and README.md. There is no OOF file, no run manifest and no results table (contrast ASSUMPTIONS A25/A26), so no number produced by this script is attributable to a specific code state.

Minor, but it is the kind of residue that makes a reader assume a filter-based selection stage exists when none does.
